candidates.change_summary: Change the required incoming ETH amount from 10 ether to 5 ether, altering whether require(msg.value) passes and thus potentially changing pastBlockTime and transfers.
Remove the timestamp ordering check so fallback no longer requires block.timestamp > pastBlockTime and will always update pastBlockTime when called with correct value.
Change the update of pastBlockTime to add 10 instead of 1, modifying the stored time and thus future comparisons.
Always perform the transfer regardless of block number by removing the if condition, which changes whether the contract balance is sent out after the call.
Invert the if condition so transfer occurs on non-multiples of 15 instead of multiples, changing when balance is paid out.
Set pastBlockTime to block.timestamp (no +1), altering the stored value and subsequent comparisons.
